title: Asking the Way
label: ch:ka-asking-the-way
canDo: I can ask how to get somewhere with … hēge hōgabēku? and how far it is, and give the way with nēravāgi, eḍakke, balakke and pakkadalli.

payoff.summary: Complete the last lesson of chapter 313: ask the way and how far it is, and give the way back.
